description: Synthetic Roblox API cache samples. Each 'cache' record maps a response body file to the cache key URL the browser would have stored it under (the URL carries parameters the artifacts read, e.g. conversation_id / messageTab / pageNumber); 'history' records are profile page visits.

records.note: conversation listing: group conversation with embedded messages, one-to-one conversation with a preview message only
truncated / partially-overwritten cache body: invalid JSON, exercises salvage of complete message objects
older page of the group conversation (conversation id read from the cache key URL)
one-to-one conversation page including moderated (visibility hidden) and deleted messages; repeats the listing's preview message to exercise duplicate collapsing
legacy web chat listing (JSON array, camelCase fields), parsed on a best-effort basis
legacy web chat messages (JSON array, senderTargetId/sent/read fields)
paged inbox listing: a Roblox system message and a user-sent scam message with HTML body, anchor href and bare URL
single message response (/v1/messages/{id}) which never appeared in a cached folder listing - exercises the single-message branch
